denied.title: This part of the studio desk isn’t open to your account
denied.body: Ask an owner or administrator to switch it on for you in Team & access.

errors.auth: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.bad_request: Check the values and try again.
errors.bad_origin: That request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the network and try again.

orders.title: Orders & payments
orders.lede: Find an order by number, name, email or phone. Take payment at the desk, or show the customer a SkipCash QR to pay on their phone.
orders.search: Order no., name, email or phone
orders.count: {count, plural, =0 {No orders} one {# order} other {# orders}}

empty.open: Nothing unpaid. Every order is settled.
empty.collect: Nothing waiting to be handed over.

orders.pick: Pick an order to see the customer, what they bought and how to take payment.

detail.closed: This order is closed. Nothing to collect.
detail.collectAfterPayment: Collected at the studio once paid
detail.refundedAll: Refunded in full ({amount}). This order is closed.

take.title: Take payment
take.qrIntro: The customer scans the code with their phone camera and pays by card or Apple Pay. The order updates here by itself.
take.qrWaiting: Waiting for the customer to pay…
take.qrOff: SkipCash isn’t connected, so the QR is off. Take payment at the desk, or ask a manager to connect SkipCash under Integrations.
take.confirmPaid: {amount} received by {method}? The customer gets their invoice by email straight away.
take.confirmCancel: Cancel order #{number}? Any class spot it holds goes back on sale.

done.paid: Payment recorded. The invoice is on its way to the customer.
done.synced: Checked with SkipCash. Nothing new yet.
done.refunded: Refunded {amount} ({method}). The customer gets an email.
done.refundedSkipcash: SkipCash accepted the refund of {amount}. It reaches their card in 5 to 10 working days.
done.classesCancelled: {count, plural, one {# class cancelled, the spot is free again.} other {# classes cancelled, the spots are free again.}}

errors.phone_required: This customer has no mobile number on file, and SkipCash needs one. Record the payment at the desk instead.
errors.payments_unavailable: SkipCash isn’t connected yet. Ask a manager to add the keys under Integrations.
errors.method_unavailable: That payment option is switched off under Integrations.
errors.payment_provider: SkipCash didn’t respond. Try again, or take payment at the desk.
errors.not_payable: This order can’t take payment any more.
errors.not_cancellable: Paid orders can’t be cancelled here.
errors.not_found: Order not found. It may have been removed.
errors.limit_reached: This customer has already used this offer.
errors.sold_out: Out of stock at this studio.
errors.unavailable: Not for sale at this studio.
errors.not_paid: Take the payment first, then hand the item over.
errors.not_refundable: This order can't be refunded: it isn't paid, or nothing is left to give back.
errors.refund_too_much: That's more than is left to refund. The order has been refreshed, check it and try again.
errors.refund_in_progress: A SkipCash refund on this order is still being processed.
errors.refund_failed: SkipCash didn't accept the refund, so nothing has changed. Try again, or give it back in cash.
errors.item_refunded: This item was refunded, so there's nothing to hand over.

new.title: Sell at the desk
new.lede: Pick the customer, the studio and everything they're buying. Then take payment: SkipCash QR or cash / card.
new.credits: {count, plural, =0 {No sessions} one {# session left} other {# sessions left}}

walkIn.title: Register a walk-in
walkIn.hint: A phone number is enough, no email needed. They can add one later.
walkIn.name: Full name
walkIn.phone_taken: This phone already belongs to a customer. Search for them instead.

phone.label: Phone for the SkipCash QR
phone.hint: This customer has no phone yet. Add one so they can pay by QR, or take cash / card.

new.pickAll: Pick a customer and at least one item to continue.
new.next: Next: SkipCash QR or cash / card.
new.maxReached: That's all the stock at this studio.

refund.title: Refund
refund.lede: Pick what's coming back and how many. The amount follows what was paid for it.
refund.notHandedOver: Not handed over yet: goes back on the shelf
refund.sessionsUsed: {left} of {total} sessions unused. Only unused ones come off; used ones stay used.
refund.restock: Put returned items back in stock
refund.restockHint: Untick if they came back damaged or can't be sold again.

methodHint.skipcash: SkipCash sends it back to the card they paid with. Banks take 5 to 10 working days.
methodHint.desk: Hand the money back at the desk now.

refund.reasonHint: For the team only. The customer doesn't see it.
refund.summary: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} coming back
refund.processingHint: Sent to SkipCash, waiting for the result. Check in SkipCash before trying again.
refund.cancelsTitle: {count, plural, one {This also cancels # upcoming class} other {This also cancels # upcoming classes}}
refund.cancelsHint: They were paid with this pack. The spots open up for others (the waitlist moves up) and the refund email tells the customer.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lede: Connect payments and email. Keys are encrypted before they’re stored and are never shown in full again.
integrations.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
integrations.willClear: Cleared on save. Falls back to the server setting, if there is one.

skipcash.title: SkipCash
skipcash.body: Card and Apple Pay payments for online checkout and the desk QR.
skipcash.liveWarn: Live takes real money. Switch only once SkipCash has given you live keys, and paste them below.
skipcash.webhookHint: Paste this into the SkipCash merchant portal so payments confirm the moment they go through.
skipcash.webhookLocal: This preview isn’t on a public https address, so SkipCash can’t reach the webhook yet. Payments still confirm when the customer comes back to the site or the desk re-checks.
skipcash.testOk: SkipCash accepted the keys ({mode}). It created a QAR 1.00 test link, which expires if nobody pays it.

resend.title: Email · Resend
resend.body: Sends sign-up verification, booking confirmations, invoices and password resets.
resend.fromHint: Leave blank for {from}. For real customers, use an address on a domain you’ve verified in Resend.
resend.replyToHint: Where customer replies go, e.g. the studio inbox.
resend.testOk: Test email sent to {to}. It should arrive within a minute.

payments.title: Payment options
payments.body: What customers can choose at checkout.
payments.onlineHint: Only offered while SkipCash is connected.
payments.atStudioHint: The customer reserves now and the front desk takes payment.
payments.holdHint: How long a spot stays held while an online payment is in progress. 5 to 120 minutes.
payments.oneRequired: Keep at least one option switched on, or nobody can check out.

errors.not_configured: Save the keys first, then test.
errors.phone_required: Add a mobile number to your own account to run a live test.

signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.lede: Use the account the studio set up for you. You'll go straight to the desk.
signIn.signedInAsCustomer: You're signed in as {email}, which isn't a staff account. Sign in with your staff account to continue.
